summary: Odyssey Therapeutics entered a share purchase agreement with TPG LSI Rise Orazio II, L.P. for a private placement of 1,388,889 common shares at $18.00 per share, concurrent with the IPO. J.P. Morgan, TD Securities, Cantor Fitzgerald, Wedbush, and Oppenheimer acted as placement agents with a 7% fee. The shares are unregistered but granted registration rights under a prior investors' rights agreement. No premium or special-situation catalyst is present; this is a standard PIPE alongside an IPO. No board recommendation or advisor was specified beyond the placement agents.
